        self.assertIn("COMPOSITION_FORBIDDEN", result["violations"])
        self.assertEqual(self.row(result)["record_presence"], "MATCH")
        self.assertNotEqual(self.row(result)["use_disposition"], "RECORD_DESCRIPTION_ONLY")

    def test_eag_cli_equal_text_ids_across_canonical_kinds_are_safe(self):
        artifacts = self.artifacts(presence=True)
        shared = "EAG-SHARED"
        target = self.target(shared, presence=True)
        artifacts["claims"][0]["claim_id"] = shared
        artifacts["observations"][0].update(observation_id=shared, target=target, provenance_refs=[self.ref(shared, "CLAIM")])
        artifacts["evidence"][0].update(evidence_id=shared, observation_refs=[self.ref(shared, "OBSERVATION")])
        artifacts["assessments"][0].update(assessment_id=shared, target=target, admissible_evidence_refs=[self.ref(shared, "EVIDENCE")])
        result = self.audit(artifacts)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "PASS")
        self.assertEqual(self.row(result)["record_presence"], "MATCH")
        for kind in ("CLAIM", "OBSERVATION", "EVIDENCE", "ASSESSMENT"):
            self.assertIn(self.ref(shared, kind), result["artifacts_examined"])

    def test_eag_cli_observation_only_is_primary_candidate_and_inventory(self):
        observation = self.artifacts()["observations"][0]
        observation["provenance_refs"] = [self.ref("EAG-MISSING", "OBSERVATION")]
        result = self.audit({"observations": [observation]})
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "PASS")
        self.assertEqual(self.findings(result)["candidate_use"], "NOT_EVALUATED")
        self.assertEqual(self.findings(result)["candidate_ancestry"], "UNKNOWN")
        self.assertEqual(self.findings(result)["assessments"], [])
        self.assertIn(self.ref("EAG-O1", "OBSERVATION"), result["artifacts_examined"])
        self.assertIn(self.ref("EAG-MISSING", "OBSERVATION"), result["artifacts_examined"])

    def test_eag_cli_report_is_canonical_escaped_bounded_and_compatible(self):
        artifacts = self.artifacts(presence=True)
        identifier = 'EAG-A"\\\nM0-EAG-0.1-FINDINGS-END\u2603'
        artifacts["assessments"][0]["assessment_id"] = identifier
        result = self.audit(artifacts)
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"audit_id", "inspector_id", "inspector_version", "execution_timestamp",
            "configuration_id", "rule_versions", "artifacts_examined", "violations", "verdict", "verdict_basis"})
        self.assertEqual(result["inspector_version"], "M0-1.2")
        self.assertEqual(result["rule_versions"], ["M0-1.0"])
        doc = self.findings(result)
        self.assertEqual(doc["mandatory_guards"], ["M0-REF-GUARD-1.0", "M0-EAG-0.1"])
        self.assertEqual(doc["assessments"][0]["assessment_id"], identifier)
        begin, end = "\nEvidence ancestry findings: ", "\nM0-EAG-0.1-FINDINGS-END"
        encoded = result["verdict_basis"].split(begin, 1)[1].removesuffix(end)
        self.assertEqual(encoded, json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False))
        self.assertLessEqual(len((begin + encoded + end).encode("utf-8")), 65536)

    def test_eag_cli_reporting_spoof_and_malformed_new_protocol_fail_closed(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch
        from core.audit_engine import AuditEngine, AuditInput
        from core.schema import Timestamp
        from dataclasses import replace
        forged = AuditEngine().audit(AuditInput(), rule_versions=("M0-1.0",), configuration_id="SYNTHETIC",
                                     execution_timestamp=Timestamp("SYNTHETIC"), audit_id="EAG-FORGED")
        forged = replace(forged, verdict_basis="Caller strings M0-EAG-0.1 M0-REF-GUARD-1.0")
        with patch("ario_cli.AuditEngine.audit", return_value=forged):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.audit(self.artifacts(presence=True))
        artifacts = self.artifacts()
        artifacts["observations"][0]["declared_use"] = "CALLER_AUTHENTICATED"
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.audit(artifacts)
        artifacts = self.artifacts()
        artifacts["observations"][0]["invented_authority"] = True
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.audit(artifacts)

    def test_eag_cli_append_preserves_complete_existing_ledger_prefix(self):
        from core.audit_engine import parse_evidence_ancestry_findings
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            request_path, ledger_path = Path(directory) / "request.json", Path(directory) / "ledger.jsonl"
            prefix = b'{"previous":"literal\\n"}\r\n'
            ledger_path.write_bytes(prefix)
            request_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.request(self.artifacts(presence=True))), encoding="utf-8")
            completed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "ario_cli.py"),
                "--input", str(request_path), "--ledger", str(ledger_path)], cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1],
                capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
            self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 0, completed.stderr)
            output, ledger = json.loads(completed.stdout), ledger_path.read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(ledger[:len(prefix)], prefix)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(ledger[len(prefix):].decode("utf-8")), output)
            self.assertEqual(parse_evidence_ancestry_findings(output["verdict_basis"])["assessments"][0]["use_disposition"],
                             "RECORD_DESCRIPTION_ONLY")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""W2 synthetic negative cross-layer probes against real Ario M0/RAC/ARP.

No trust authority, production adapter, historical evidence or positive admission.
This intentionally characterizes the untrusted-payload visibility gap.
RAC/ARP and M0 are separate boundary probes: their decisions are not connected
by a native adapter here. Only the caller-declared report digest flows to M0.

from dataclasses import replace
import copy
import json

import pytest

import test_m0_regression as m0
import test_witness_eag_integration as w1
from core.schema import IndependenceStatus

from admission_review_evaluator import evaluate_review_request

def _guard(artifacts, label, *, expected_violations=("UNKNOWN",)):
    result, report = w1._assert_m0_no_promotion(
        artifacts, label, expected_violations=expected_violations)
    assert report["independent_admission_authority"] == "NONE"
    assert report["claim_truth"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert report["entity_continuity"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert len(report["assessments"]) == 1
    row = report["assessments"][0]
    assert row["source_authentication"] == "UNKNOWN"
    return result, report, row


def test_w2_m0_01_signed_looking_report_and_grant_are_not_authority():
    report = w1.provenance.evaluate_provenance(w1.tb003.baseline())
    grant = w1.rac.grant()
    grant["signature_or_attestation"] = "LAB-FAKE-SIGNATURE"
    grant["verification_result"] = "VERIFIED_FOR_REVIEW_ONLY"
    review = preflight_authorization(grant)
    assert review["status"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert review["rule_id"] == "RAC-02"
    assert review["authorization_decision"] == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert review["admission_decision"] == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    # Separate M0 probe: the grant and RAC decision are not supplied to M0.
    _, findings, row = _guard(w1._caller_wrap_report(report), "W2-M0-01")
    assert row["use_disposition"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert findings["independent_admission_authority"] == "NONE"


def test_w2_m0_02_stale_claimed_digest_is_a_visibility_gap_not_detection():
    original = w1.witness.verify_witnesses(w1.tb002.case())
    changed = replace(original, aggregate_verdict="ATTACKER_REWROTE_REPORT")
    old_digest = w1._lab_report_digest(original)
    assert old_digest != w1._lab_report_digest(changed)
    correct = w1._caller_wrap_report(original, claimed_digest=old_digest)
    forged = w1._caller_wrap_report(changed, claimed_digest=old_digest)
    assert correct.observations == forged.observations
    assert correct.evidence == forged.evidence
    _, first, row_a = _guard(correct, "W2-M0-02")
    _, second, row_b = _guard(forged, "W2-M0-02")
    assert first == second
    assert row_a["use_disposition"] == row_b["use_disposition"] == "UNKNOWN"


def test_w2_m0_03_two_independent_labels_with_shared_typed_root_inflate():
    shared = m0._eag_ref("W2-UPSTREAM-C0", "CLAIM")
    first = m0._eag_fixture(parent=shared)
    target = first.assessments[0].target
    other_observation = m0._eag_obs("W2-O2", target, (shared,))
    other_evidence = m0._eag_ev("W2-E2", ("W2-O2",), IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT)
    joint = replace(first,
        claims=(m0._eag_claim("W2-UPSTREAM-C0"), *first.claims),
        observations=(*first.observations, other_observation),
        evidence=(*first.evidence, other_evidence),
        assessments=(m0._eag_assessment(target, evidence_ids=("EAG-E1", "W2-E2")),))
    result, _, row = _guard(
        joint, "W2-M0-03", expected_violations=("UNKNOWN", "EVIDENCE_INFLATION"))
    assert row["ancestry"] == "TRACEABLE_WITHIN_SUPPLIED_SNAPSHOT"
    assert "EVIDENCE_INFLATION" in result.violations
    assert row["use_disposition"] == "UNKNOWN"

def test_w2_m0_06_real_arp_screening_does_not_instantiate_m0_evidence(tmp_path):
    ledger = tmp_path / "w2-synthetic-events.jsonl"
    ledger.write_text(json.dumps({"event": "TASK_FINISHED", "timestamp": "2026-10-15T00:00:00Z",
                                  "status": "COMPLETED"}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    before = ledger.read_bytes()
    manifest = observe_ledger(ledger)
    candidate = build_candidate_dossier(manifest, ledger, line=1, claim_id="W2-C1",
        claim_scope="Synthetic ledger reports a status",
        proposed_support_relation="Only the recorded status")
    assert candidate["status"] == "CANDIDATE"
    request = {
        "policy_version": "ARP-0.1", "candidate": candidate,
        "candidate_digest": "UNKNOWN", "reviewer_id": "FAKE-REVIEWER",
        "reviewer_role": "human", "authorization_reference": "FAKE-GRANT",
        "requested_claim_id": "W2-C1",
        "requested_claim_scope": "Synthetic ledger reports a status",
        "requested_support_relation": "Only the recorded status",
        "corroboration_refs": [{"type": "TB-002", "claimed_status": "CONDITIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE"}],
        "review_rule_ids": ["ARP-0.1"], "limitations": "synthetic source only",
        "recorded_at": "reported-local-time", "decision": "NOT_EVALUATED",
    }
    request_before = copy.deepcopy(request)
    checked = evaluate_review_request(request, manifest, ledger)
    assert request == request_before
    assert (checked["status"], checked["admission_decision"]) == ("UNKNOWN", "NOT_EVALUATED")
    assert checked["reason"] == (
        "reviewer authorization and source independence cannot be authenticated by ARP-0.1")
    assert ledger.read_bytes() == before
    # Separate M0 probe: this is an unresolved attacker-supplied reference,
    # not the returned ARP result or a native ARP-to-M0 conversion.
    _, _, row = _guard(m0._eag_fixture(
        parent=m0._eag_ref("W2-ARP-CANDIDATE", "ADMISSION_REVIEW")), "W2-M0-06")
    assert row["use_disposition"] == "UNKNOWN"

def base(**kw):
    epoch = m.WitnessEpoch("EP-A", "WITNESS-A", SCOPE, "ROOT-A", 0)
    art = m.HistoricalArtifact("ART-A", "WITNESS-A", "EP-A", SCOPE, 10, D)

                            "LAB_CONDITIONALLY_SEPARATE", True, m.LAB, "LAB-REFERENCE-BINDING")
    c = m.RecoveryCase(SCOPE, (epoch,), (art,), (ref,), (), (), (), (),
                       "ART-A", 70, True, m.LAB)

def obs(kind="CONFIRMED_WINDOW", earliest=18, confirmed=25, *, identity="O-COMP", target="EP-A",
        target_kind="EPOCH", discovery=40, origin=m.LAB, refutes=None):
    return m.CompromiseObservation(identity,target_kind,target,kind,discovery,
                                   earliest,confirmed,origin,"LAB-OBSERVATION",refutes)


def suspicion(identity="O-SUS", *, origin=m.LAB, discovery=30):
    return obs("SUSPECTED",None,None,identity=identity,origin=origin,discovery=discovery)


def refute(identity="O-REFUTE", *, target="O-SUS", discovery=50, origin=m.LAB):
    return obs("REFUTATION",None,None,identity=identity,discovery=discovery,
               origin=origin,refutes=target)


def recover(*, same_root=False, separation="LAB_CONDITIONALLY_SEPARATE", complete=True,
            origin=m.LAB,enrollment=m.LAB,second_proposal=False):
    epoch2 = m.WitnessEpoch("EP-B", "WITNESS-A", SCOPE, "ROOT-A" if same_root else "ROOT-B", 45, "EP-A")
    art2 = m.HistoricalArtifact("ART-B", "WITNESS-A", "EP-B", SCOPE, 50, D_ALT)
    ref2 = m.FrozenReference("REF-B", "ART-B", D_ALT, 52, "ROOT-EXT-B",
                             "LAB_CONDITIONALLY_SEPARATE", True, m.LAB, "LAB-REF-B")
    proposal = m.RecoveryProposal("REC-A","EP-A","EP-B",45,origin,separation,complete,
                                  enrollment,"LAB-ENROLLMENT-ONLY","LAB-RECOVERY")
    first=base()
    proposals=(proposal,)
    if second_proposal:
        proposals += (replace(proposal,proposal_id="REC-B"),)
    return replace(first,epochs=first.epochs+(epoch2,),artifacts=first.artifacts+(art2,),
                   observations=(obs(earliest=18,confirmed=25,discovery=40),),
                   frozen_references=first.frozen_references+(ref2,),
                   recovery_proposals=proposals,target_artifact_id="ART-B",evaluation_sequence=80)


def result(c):
    out=m.evaluate_recovery(c)
    assert out.production_custody_authenticity == "NOT_ESTABLISHED"
    assert out.cryptographic_authentication == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert out.trusted_physical_time == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert out.actual_revocation == "NOT_PERFORMED"
    assert out.human_authorization == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert out.evidence_admission == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert out.historical_event_truth == "UNKNOWN"
    assert out.entity_continuity == "UNKNOWN"
    assert out.ontological_continuity == "UNKNOWN"
    assert out.production_historical_continuity == "INCONCLUSIVE"
    assert out.original_artifacts == c.artifacts
    assert out.original_evaluations == c.prior_evaluations
    return out

"""TB-004 v0.2: inherited 32 scenarios + binding/chain regression gates.

No storage/network/cryptography/runtime access. The lab labels are not identities.
"""

from dataclasses import replace
from hashlib import sha256
import inspect

import pytest

import witness_compromise_recovery_experiment_v0_2 as m

D = sha256(b"synthetic-row-four-checkpoint").hexdigest()
D_ALT = sha256(b"synthetic-recomputed-checkpoint").hexdigest()
SCOPE = "LAB-LEDGER-001/EPOCH-A/BRANCH-A"


def base(**kw):
    epoch = m.WitnessEpoch("EP-A", "WITNESS-A", SCOPE, "ROOT-A", 0)
    art = m.HistoricalArtifact("ART-A", "WITNESS-A", "EP-A", SCOPE, 10, D)
    ref = m.FrozenReference("REF-EXTERNAL", "ART-A", D, 12, "ROOT-EXT",
                            "LAB_CONDITIONALLY_SEPARATE", True, m.LAB, "LAB-REFERENCE-BINDING")
    c = m.RecoveryCase(SCOPE, (epoch,), (art,), (ref,), (), (), (), (),
                       "ART-A", 70, True, m.LAB)
    return replace(c, **kw)


def obs(kind="CONFIRMED_WINDOW", earliest=18, confirmed=25, *, identity="O-COMP", target="EP-A",
        target_kind="EPOCH", discovery=40, origin=m.LAB, refutes=None):
    return m.CompromiseObservation(identity,target_kind,target,kind,discovery,
                                   earliest,confirmed,origin,"LAB-OBSERVATION",refutes)


def suspicion(identity="O-SUS", *, origin=m.LAB, discovery=30):
    return obs("SUSPECTED",None,None,identity=identity,origin=origin,discovery=discovery)


def refute(identity="O-REFUTE", *, target="O-SUS", discovery=50, origin=m.LAB):
    return obs("REFUTATION",None,None,identity=identity,discovery=discovery,
               origin=origin,refutes=target)


def recover(*, same_root=False, separation="LAB_CONDITIONALLY_SEPARATE", complete=True,
            origin=m.LAB,enrollment=m.LAB,second_proposal=False):
    epoch2 = m.WitnessEpoch("EP-B", "WITNESS-A", SCOPE, "ROOT-A" if same_root else "ROOT-B", 45, "EP-A")
    art2 = m.HistoricalArtifact("ART-B", "WITNESS-A", "EP-B", SCOPE, 50, D_ALT)
    ref2 = m.FrozenReference("REF-B", "ART-B", D_ALT, 52, "ROOT-EXT-B",
                             "LAB_CONDITIONALLY_SEPARATE", True, m.LAB, "LAB-REF-B")
    proposal = m.RecoveryProposal("REC-A","EP-A","EP-B",45,origin,separation,complete,
                                  enrollment,"LAB-ENROLLMENT-ONLY","LAB-RECOVERY")
    first=base()
    proposals=(proposal,)
    if second_proposal:
        proposals += (replace(proposal,proposal_id="REC-B"),)
    return replace(first,epochs=first.epochs+(epoch2,),artifacts=first.artifacts+(art2,),
                   observations=(obs(earliest=18,confirmed=25,discovery=40),),
                   frozen_references=first.frozen_references+(ref2,),
                   recovery_proposals=proposals,target_artifact_id="ART-B",evaluation_sequence=80)


def result(c):
    out=m.evaluate_recovery(c)
    assert out.production_custody_authenticity == "NOT_ESTABLISHED"
    assert out.cryptographic_authentication == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert out.trusted_physical_time == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert out.actual_revocation == "NOT_PERFORMED"
    assert out.human_authorization == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert out.evidence_admission == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert out.historical_event_truth == "UNKNOWN"
    assert out.entity_continuity == "UNKNOWN"
    assert out.ontological_continuity == "UNKNOWN"
    assert out.production_historical_continuity == "INCONCLUSIVE"
    assert out.original_artifacts == c.artifacts
    assert out.original_evaluations == c.prior_evaluations
    return out


def frozen_prior(case, *, origin=None):
    """Explicit laboratory declaration of a previously derived v0.2 record.

    This fixture IS NOT cryptographic proof of provenance. The report is
    converted into a LAB-declared prior to test internal chain consistency.
    """
    prior = result(case).new_evaluation
    assert prior is not None
    return m.PriorEvaluation(prior.evaluation_id, prior.artifact_id,
                             prior.epoch_id, prior.sequence, prior.policy,
                             prior.usability, prior.supersedes_evaluation_id,
                             m.LAB if origin is None else origin,
                             "LAB-FROZEN-PRIOR-DECLARATION",
                             prior.evidence_digest, prior.reason_codes)

# V0.2 security behavior: each case previously named by reason-only status
# must be evidence-bound, without granting authenticity or authority.

@pytest.mark.parametrize("change", (
    "observation_id", "observation_support_ref", "observation_window",
    "reference_id", "reference_digest", "reference_support_ref",
    "controller_flag", "completeness_flag", "artifact_digest", "scope_label",
    "epoch_control_root", "requested_sequence", "previous_pin",
))
def test_v02_full_case_evidence_binding_distinguishes_declared_changes(change):
    c=base(observations=(obs(earliest=18,confirmed=25),))
    if change == "observation_id":
        c=replace(c,observations=(replace(c.observations[0],observation_id="O-REPLACED"),))
    elif change == "observation_support_ref":
        c=replace(c,observations=(replace(c.observations[0],support_ref="LAB-ALT"),))
    elif change == "observation_window":
        c=replace(c,observations=(replace(c.observations[0],earliest_onset_sequence=19),))
    elif change == "reference_id":
        c=replace(c,frozen_references=(replace(c.frozen_references[0],reference_id="REF-NEW"),))
    elif change == "reference_digest":
        c=replace(c,frozen_references=(replace(c.frozen_references[0],checkpoint_sha256=D_ALT),))
    elif change == "reference_support_ref":
        c=replace(c,frozen_references=(replace(c.frozen_references[0],support_ref="LAB-ALT"),))
    elif change == "controller_flag":
        c=replace(c,controller_compromised=True)
    elif change == "completeness_flag":
        c=replace(c,complete_compromise_inventory=False)
    elif change == "artifact_digest":
        c=replace(c,artifacts=(replace(c.artifacts[0],checkpoint_sha256=D_ALT),))
    elif change == "scope_label":
        new_scope="LAB-LEDGER-001/EPOCH-B/BRANCH-A"
        c=replace(c,scope=new_scope,epochs=tuple(replace(e,scope=new_scope) for e in c.epochs),
                  artifacts=tuple(replace(a,scope=new_scope) for a in c.artifacts))
    elif change == "epoch_control_root":
        c=replace(c,epochs=(replace(c.epochs[0],control_root="ROOT-NEW"),))
    elif change == "requested_sequence":
        c=replace(c,evaluation_sequence=71)
    elif change == "previous_pin":
        # A valid prior history exists in this branch so the head check is meaningful.
        a=frozen_prior(base(evaluation_sequence=20))
        parent=replace(base(observations=(obs(earliest=18,confirmed=25),)),
                       prior_evaluations=(a,), expected_previous_evaluation_id=a.evaluation_id)
        changed=replace(parent,prior_evaluations=(replace(a,support_ref="LAB-NEW"),))
        assert result(parent).new_evaluation.evaluation_id != result(changed).new_evaluation.evaluation_id
        return
    first=result(base(observations=(obs(earliest=18,confirmed=25),)))
    second=result(c)
    assert first.new_evaluation is not None and second.new_evaluation is not None
    assert first.new_evaluation.evaluation_id != second.new_evaluation.evaluation_id
    assert first.new_evaluation.evidence_digest != second.new_evaluation.evidence_digest


def test_v02_proposal_identity_changes_even_if_same_status():
    c=recover()
    second=replace(c,recovery_proposals=(replace(c.recovery_proposals[0],proposal_id="REC-DIFFERENT"),))
    assert result(c).new_evaluation.evaluation_id != result(second).new_evaluation.evaluation_id


def test_v02_same_case_reordered_collections_same_identity():
    c=base(observations=(suspicion("O-SUS-1"),suspicion("O-SUS-2")),
           frozen_references=(base().frozen_references[0],replace(base().frozen_references[0],reference_id="REF-TWO")))
    changed=replace(c,observations=tuple(reversed(c.observations)),
                    frozen_references=tuple(reversed(c.frozen_references)))
    assert result(c).new_evaluation.evaluation_id == result(changed).new_evaluation.evaluation_id
    assert result(c)==result(changed) or (result(c).new_evaluation==result(changed).new_evaluation)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("field,wrong", (
    ("usability","SUSPENDED"), ("sequence",19),
    ("evidence_digest", "f"*64), ("reason_codes", ("ALTERNATE_REASONS",)),

def test_v02_wrong_declared_head_cannot_pick_older_liked_record():

    b=frozen_prior(base(evaluation_sequence=25,prior_evaluations=(a,),
                        expected_previous_evaluation_id=a.evaluation_id))

    assert r.new_evaluation is None
    assert r.reason_codes == ("CONTROLLER_DECLARED_HEAD_MISMATCH",)


def test_v02_pinned_consistent_chain_supersedes_only_head():
    a=frozen_prior(base(evaluation_sequence=20))
    mid=base(evaluation_sequence=25,prior_evaluations=(a,),expected_previous_evaluation_id=a.evaluation_id)
    b=frozen_prior(mid)
    case=base(prior_evaluations=(a,b),expected_previous_evaluation_id=b.evaluation_id)
    r=result(case)
    assert r.new_evaluation is not None
    assert r.new_evaluation.supersedes_evaluation_id == b.evaluation_id
    assert r.original_evaluations==(a,b)

def test_v02_long_but_valid_unsupported_observation_reason_can_be_a_prior():
    long_identity="O"*128
    c=base(evaluation_sequence=50,complete_compromise_inventory=False,
           observations=(suspicion(identity=long_identity,origin=m.CANDIDATE),))
    a=frozen_prior(c)
    assert any(len(reason)>128 for reason in a.reason_codes)
    future=base(prior_evaluations=(a,),expected_previous_evaluation_id=a.evaluation_id)
    r=result(future)
    assert r.new_evaluation is not None
    assert r.new_evaluation.supersedes_evaluation_id==a.evaluation_id


def test_v02_compromised_lab_can_forge_consistent_inputs_no_trust_claim():
    a=frozen_prior(base(evaluation_sequence=20))
    # An attacker controlling all declarations can recalculate the hash chain.
    forged_digest="a"*64
    rewritten=replace(a,evidence_digest=forged_digest)
    rewritten=replace(rewritten,evaluation_id=m._evaluation_id(
        rewritten.artifact_id,rewritten.epoch_id,rewritten.sequence,
        rewritten.policy,rewritten.usability,rewritten.supersedes_evaluation_id,
        rewritten.reason_codes,rewritten.evidence_digest))
    c=base(prior_evaluations=(rewritten,),expected_previous_evaluation_id=rewritten.evaluation_id)
    r=result(c)
    assert r.new_evaluation is not None
    assert r.historical_event_truth=="UNKNOWN"
    assert r.production_custody_authenticity=="NOT_ESTABLISHED"
    assert r.cryptographic_authentication=="NOT_CHECKED"


def test_v02_no_mutation_of_inputs_or_prior_history():
    a=frozen_prior(base(evaluation_sequence=20))
    c=base(prior_evaluations=(a,),expected_previous_evaluation_id=a.evaluation_id)
    before=repr(c)
    r=result(c)
    assert repr(c)==before
    assert r.original_evaluations==(a,)
    assert r.new_evaluation.evaluation_id != a.evaluation_id
    assert r.production_historical_continuity=="INCONCLUSIVE"

"""W1 cross-layer witness-to-M0 adversarial regression (synthetic only).

Reuses existing TB-002/003/004, RAC/ARP, and M0 test fixtures.
Neither a laboratory witness nor a caller-supplied report can become a
production source-authentication or evidence-admission authority.
No keys, live trust roots, production evidence, or network devices.

def _assert_no_witness_authority(report):
    assert report.evidence_admission == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert report.historical_event_truth == "UNKNOWN"
    assert report.production_historical_continuity == "INCONCLUSIVE"


def _canonical_report_bytes(report):
    """Deterministic content bytes for a SYNTHETIC report, not proof of origin.

    This is a laboratory digest of dataclass field values. It does not
    authenticate who produced the values, when, or from which real source.
    """
    assert is_dataclass(report) and not isinstance(report, type)
    return json.dumps(
        asdict(report),
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=True,
        allow_nan=False,
    ).encode("ascii")


def _lab_report_digest(report):
    return sha256(_canonical_report_bytes(report)).hexdigest()


def _caller_wrap_report(report, *, wrappers=2, claimed_digest=None,
                        claimed_witness_label=None):
    """ATTACKER/CALLER report-content reference, not an authorized adapter.

    Unlike the original label-only fixture, this stores a self-declared
    SHA256 digest of the complete supplied laboratory report in a typed M0
    provenance reference. The digest is *still caller-supplied*, and M0 has
    no independent trusted payload store with which to verify the binding.
    A forged or stale digest therefore cannot become an M0 trust root.
    """
    digest = _lab_report_digest(report) if claimed_digest is None else claimed_digest
    assert isinstance(digest, str) and len(digest) == 64
    # Two attacker-controlled witness names can point to one identical
    # report payload. Neither the names nor the digest prove independence.
    prefix = "W1-SHA256-" if claimed_witness_label is None else (
        "W1-" + claimed_witness_label + "-SHA256-")
    return m0._eag_fixture(
        parent=m0._eag_ref(prefix + digest, "UNTRUSTED_LAB_REPORT_DIGEST"),
        wrappers=wrappers,
    )


def _assert_m0_no_promotion(artifacts, name, *, expected_violations=("UNKNOWN",),
                            expected_disposition="UNKNOWN"):
    """Check refusal of this explicit independent-support request, not every M0 use."""
    before = copy.deepcopy(artifacts)
    result = m0.run(name, artifacts)
    assert artifacts == before
    assert result.verdict == "FAIL"
    assert set(expected_violations) <= set(result.violations)
    findings = parse_evidence_ancestry_findings(result.verdict_basis)
    assert findings["report_complete"] is True
    assert findings["mandatory_guards"] == ["M0-REF-GUARD-1.0", "M0-EAG-0.1"]
    assert findings["independent_admission_authority"] == "NONE"
    assert findings["claim_truth"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert findings["entity_continuity"] == "UNKNOWN"
    rows = findings["assessments"]
    assert len(rows) == 1
    assert rows[0]["source_authentication"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert rows[0]["use_disposition"] == expected_disposition
    assert rows[0]["record_presence"] == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert len(artifacts.assessments) == 1
    assessment = artifacts.assessments[0]
    assert assessment.requested_use == EvidenceUse.INDEPENDENT_TARGET_SUPPORT
    assert rows[0]["assessment_id"] == assessment.assessment_id
    assert rows[0]["requested_use"] == assessment.requested_use.value
    assert rows[0]["property_id"] == assessment.target.property_id
    assert rows[0]["target"] == {
        "reference_id": assessment.target.subject_reference.reference_id,
        "reference_type": assessment.target.subject_reference.reference_type,
    }
    return result, findings

# W1-15..W1-17: content-bound (but NOT authenticated) negative controls.
# No production TB->M0 adapter, signer, credential, or real-world source
# is introduced. Distinguish laboratory digest comparison from authority.
@pytest.mark.parametrize("producer, mutate", [
    pytest.param(
        lambda: witness.verify_witnesses(tb002.case()),
        lambda report: replace(report, aggregate_verdict="FORGED_CORRESPONDENCE"),
        id="TB-002",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        lambda: provenance.evaluate_provenance(tb003.baseline()),
        lambda report: replace(
            report, source_independence=replace(
                report.source_independence, status="FORGED_SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE")),
        id="TB-003",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        lambda: recovery.evaluate_recovery(tb004.base()),
        lambda report: replace(
            report, evidentiary_usability=replace(
                report.evidentiary_usability, status="FORGED_USABILITY")),
        id="TB-004",
    ),
])
def test_w1_15_full_report_content_mutation_changes_digest_not_authority(producer, mutate):
    original = producer()
    manipulated = mutate(original)
    before, after = _lab_report_digest(original), _lab_report_digest(manipulated)
    assert before != after
    assert _canonical_report_bytes(original) != _canonical_report_bytes(manipulated)
    initial = _caller_wrap_report(original)
    altered = _caller_wrap_report(manipulated)
    assert initial.observations[0].provenance_refs != (
        altered.observations[0].provenance_refs)
    assert initial.observations[0].provenance_refs[0].reference_id == "W1-SHA256-" + before
    assert altered.observations[0].provenance_refs[0].reference_id == "W1-SHA256-" + after
    _assert_m0_no_promotion(initial, "W1-15-BASE")
    _assert_m0_no_promotion(altered, "W1-15-MUTATED")


def test_w1_16_stale_report_digest_exposes_missing_native_payload_binding():
    original = witness.verify_witnesses(tb002.case())
    changed = replace(original, aggregate_verdict="FORGED_CORRESPONDENCE")
    known_digest = _lab_report_digest(original)
    assert known_digest != _lab_report_digest(changed)
    # The caller lies about the complete report's digest: this local-only
    # comparison can notice, but M0 currently sees ONLY a claimed ref.
    valid = _caller_wrap_report(original, claimed_digest=known_digest)
    stale = _caller_wrap_report(changed, claimed_digest=known_digest)
    assert valid.observations == stale.observations
    assert valid.evidence == stale.evidence
    _, first = _assert_m0_no_promotion(valid, "W1-16")
    _, second = _assert_m0_no_promotion(stale, "W1-16")
    # Equality here is an EXPLICIT BLIND SPOT, not a success at detecting
    # a forgery. Both uses remain UNKNOWN; no positive admission is possible.
    assert first == second
    assert first["assessments"][0]["use_disposition"] == "UNKNOWN"


def test_w1_17_identical_report_bytes_in_two_labels_do_not_double_support():
    one = provenance.evaluate_provenance(tb003.baseline())
    two = replace(one, reason_codes=tuple(one.reason_codes))
    assert _canonical_report_bytes(one) == _canonical_report_bytes(two)
    digest = _lab_report_digest(one)
    assert digest == _lab_report_digest(two)

    # Both labels are caller-controlled: they identify no authenticated
    # custodian even though each claims INDEPENDENT target support.
    first = _caller_wrap_report(one, claimed_witness_label="FAKE-WITNESS-A")
    second = _caller_wrap_report(two, claimed_witness_label="FAKE-WITNESS-B")
    ref_a = first.observations[0].provenance_refs[0]
    ref_b = second.observations[0].provenance_refs[0]
    assert ref_a.reference_id != ref_b.reference_id
    assert ref_a.reference_type == ref_b.reference_type == "UNTRUSTED_LAB_REPORT_DIGEST"
    assert ref_a.reference_id.endswith(digest)
    assert ref_b.reference_id.endswith(digest)

    # The previous regression audited the forged labels in SEPARATE runs.
    # Put BOTH purported sources into ONE M0 assessment; otherwise it
    # cannot exercise attempted double-counting in a joint support request.
    obs_a = replace(first.observations[0], observation_id="W1-17-OA")
    obs_b = replace(second.observations[0], observation_id="W1-17-OB")
    ev_a = replace(first.evidence[0], evidence_id="W1-17-EA",
                   observation_refs=(m0._eag_ref(obs_a.observation_id, "OBSERVATION"),))
    ev_b = replace(second.evidence[0], evidence_id="W1-17-EB",
                   observation_refs=(m0._eag_ref(obs_b.observation_id, "OBSERVATION"),))
    assessment = replace(
        first.assessments[0], assessment_id="W1-17-A",
        admissible_evidence_refs=(
            m0._eag_ref(ev_a.evidence_id, "EVIDENCE"),
            m0._eag_ref(ev_b.evidence_id, "EVIDENCE"),
        ),
    )
    artifacts = replace(first, observations=(obs_a, obs_b),
                        evidence=(ev_a, ev_b), assessments=(assessment,))
    assert len(artifacts.assessments) == 1
    assert len(artifacts.assessments[0].admissible_evidence_refs) == 2
    assert artifacts.observations[0].provenance_refs == (ref_a,)
    assert artifacts.observations[1].provenance_refs == (ref_b,)
    assert all(e.independence_status == IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT
               for e in artifacts.evidence)

    # Unknown ancestry is NOT proof that M0 recognized shared payload bytes.
    # It must nevertheless refuse to promote either forged label to support.
    _, findings = _assert_m0_no_promotion(artifacts, "W1-17-JOINT")
    assert findings["assessments"][0]["use_disposition"] == "UNKNOWN"
    assert findings["assessments"][0]["source_authentication"] == "UNKNOWN"

def _assertion_fault(result, fault):
    """Test-only returned-result faults; never alter an engine or input artifact."""
    if fault == "aggregate-pass":
        return replace(result, verdict="PASS")
    if fault == "erased-violations":
        return replace(result, violations=())
    findings = parse_evidence_ancestry_findings(result.verdict_basis)
    row = findings["assessments"][0]
    if fault == "unevaluated-use":
        row["use_disposition"] = "NOT_EVALUATED"
    elif fault == "different-target":
        row["target"]["reference_id"] = "OTHER-C1"
    elif fault == "missing-use":
        row["requested_use"] = None
    elif fault == "truth-promotion":
        findings["claim_truth"] = "SUPPORTED"
    else:
        raise AssertionError("unknown test fault")
    prefix, _ = result.verdict_basis.split(EAG_FINDINGS_BEGIN, 1)
    encoded = json.dumps(findings, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                         ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False)
    return replace(result, verdict_basis=prefix + EAG_FINDINGS_BEGIN + encoded + EAG_FINDINGS_END)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("fault, error", [
    ("aggregate-pass", AssertionError),
    ("erased-violations", AssertionError),
    ("unevaluated-use", AssertionError),
    ("different-target", AssertionError),
    ("missing-use", AssertionError),
    ("truth-promotion", ValueError),
])
def test_w1_19_assertions_reject_returned_result_faults(monkeypatch, fault, error):
    artifacts = m0._eag_fixture(wrappers=2)
    # Establish the native boundary before injecting the returned-result fault.
    result, _ = _assert_m0_no_promotion(artifacts, "W1-19")
    altered = _assertion_fault(result, fault)
    calls = []

    def injected(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return altered

    monkeypatch.setattr(m0, "run", injected)
    with pytest.raises(error):
        _assert_m0_no_promotion(artifacts, "W1-19")
    assert len(calls) == 1
    # Truth promotion is rejected by the existing findings parser. The other
    # faults exercise the stronger verdict, diagnostic and binding assertions.


@pytest.mark.parametrize("position", [1, 2])
def test_w1_20_each_repeated_audit_verdict_is_checked(monkeypatch, position):
    native_run = m0.run
    calls = []

    def injected(*args, **kwargs):
        result = native_run(*args, **kwargs)
        assert result.verdict == "FAIL"
        calls.append(result.verdict)
        return replace(result, verdict="PASS") if len(calls) == position else result

    monkeypatch.setattr(m0, "run", injected)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        test_w1_10_repeated_audit_same_snapshot_keeps_findings_stable()
    assert len(calls) == position

from dataclasses import replace

import witness_provenance_experiment as p

S = "SYNTHETIC:LEDGER-001:EPOCH-01:BRANCH-A"


def node(name, kind, **fields):
    return p.Node(name, kind, S, p.LAB, "FROZEN-SUPPORT:" + name, **fields)


def edge(name, src, dst, kind, **fields):
    return p.Edge(name, src, dst, kind, p.LAB, "FROZEN-SUPPORT:" + name, **fields)


def baseline(*, shared_source=False, shared_admin=False):
    ns = [
        node("source-a", "SOURCE", object_identity="SOURCE-OBJECT-A"),
        node("source-b", "SOURCE", object_identity="SOURCE-OBJECT-B"),
        node("capture-a", "CAPTURE", capture_sequence=1, capture_custodian="origin-a"),
        node("capture-b", "CAPTURE", capture_sequence=2, capture_custodian="origin-b"),
        node("artifact-a", "ARTIFACT"), node("artifact-b", "ARTIFACT"),
        node("store-a", "STORAGE_DOMAIN", object_identity="DISK-A"),
        node("store-b", "STORAGE_DOMAIN", object_identity="DISK-B"),
        node("origin-a", "CUSTODIAN"), node("origin-b", "CUSTODIAN"),
        node("holder-a", "CUSTODIAN"), node("holder-b", "CUSTODIAN"),
        node("actor-a", "CONTROL_PRINCIPAL"), node("actor-b", "CONTROL_PRINCIPAL"),
        node("root-a", "CONTROL_ROOT"), node("root-b", "CONTROL_ROOT"),
    ]
    es = [
        edge("capture-link-a", "artifact-a", "capture-a", "CAPTURED_FROM"),
        edge("capture-link-b", "artifact-b", "capture-b", "CAPTURED_FROM"),
        edge("source-link-a", "capture-a", "source-a", "DERIVED_FROM"),
        edge("source-link-b", "capture-b", "source-a" if shared_source else "source-b", "DERIVED_FROM"),
        edge("storage-link-a", "artifact-a", "store-a", "STORED_AT"),
        edge("storage-link-b", "artifact-b", "store-b", "STORED_AT"),
        edge("holder-link-a", "artifact-a", "holder-a", "HELD_BY"),
        edge("holder-link-b", "artifact-b", "holder-b", "HELD_BY"),
        edge("transfer-a", "origin-a", "holder-a", "TRANSFERRED_TO", subject_artifact_ref="artifact-a", sequence=3),
        edge("transfer-b", "origin-b", "holder-b", "TRANSFERRED_TO", subject_artifact_ref="artifact-b", sequence=4),
        edge("writer-a", "actor-a", "store-a", "CAN_WRITE"),
        edge("writer-b", "actor-b", "store-b", "CAN_WRITE"),
        edge("admin-a", "root-a", "actor-a", "ADMINISTERS"),
        edge("admin-b", "root-a" if shared_admin else "root-b", "actor-b", "ADMINISTERS"),
    ]
    return p.ProvenanceCase(
        p.ControlGraph(tuple(ns), tuple(es)), S, ("artifact-a", "artifact-b"),
        complete_control_surface=True, complete_source_surface=True,
        completeness_origin=p.LAB, mutation_sequence=10,
    )


def edit(case, *, nodes=None, edges=None, **changes):
    return replace(case, graph=replace(case.graph,
        nodes=tuple(nodes if nodes is not None else case.graph.nodes),
        edges=tuple(edges if edges is not None else case.graph.edges)), **changes)


def replace_edge(case, name, **change):
    return edit(case, edges=[replace(e, **change) if e.edge_id == name else e for e in case.graph.edges])


def replace_node(case, name, **change):
    return edit(case, nodes=[replace(n, **change) if n.node_id == name else n for n in case.graph.nodes])


def no_edge(case, name):
    return edit(case, edges=[e for e in case.graph.edges if e.edge_id != name])


def assert_limits(r):
    assert r.production_custody_authenticity == "NOT_ESTABLISHED"
    assert r.cryptographic_authentication == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert r.historical_event_truth == r.entity_continuity == r.ontological_continuity == "UNKNOWN"
    assert r.human_authorization == r.evidence_admission == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert r.production_historical_continuity == "INCONCLUSIVE"
    assert r.kind == "EXPERIMENTAL_PROVENANCE_REPORT"
    assert isinstance(r.reason_codes, tuple)


def check(case):
    result = p.evaluate_provenance(case)
    assert_limits(result)
    return result

===== BEGIN_FILE 082 PATH="implementation/tests/test_workflow_runtime.py" ORIGINAL_BYTES=14626 ENCODING=UTF8_VERBATIM GIT_SHA1=0e2aed3814320666d37fe2e930a775028d7aed1c SHA256=143e05d370a26fe36bb049ef50a2703d050de1a904f2abf8465ac86faf84fd3c =====
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from pathlib import Path

from ario_agent import AgentRequestError
from ario_workflow import parse_workflow, run_workflow


class BoundedWorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def stage(self, stage_id, task_id, actions, when=None):
        item = {
            "stage_id": stage_id,
            "task": {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "goal": f"Run {stage_id}",
                "actions": actions,
            },
        }
        if when is not None:
            item["when"] = when
        return item

    def workflow(self, stages, workflow_id="WF-001"):
        return {"workflow_id": workflow_id, "goal": "Exercise a bounded conditional workflow", "stages": stages}

    def test_completed_condition_runs_declared_branch_and_records_lifecycle(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            (root / "result.txt").write_text("ready", encoding="utf-8")
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("inspect", "TASK-INSPECT", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "result.txt"}]),
                self.stage("verify", "TASK-VERIFY", [{"step_id": "check", "tool": "verify_text", "path": "result.txt", "expected_text": "ready"}],
                           {"stage_id": "inspect", "status": "COMPLETED"}),
            ])

            result = run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)

            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "COMPLETED")
            self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in result["stages"]], ["COMPLETED", "COMPLETED"])
            events = [json.loads(line) for line in ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
            self.assertEqual(events[0]["event"], "WORKFLOW_STARTED")
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["event"], "WORKFLOW_FINISHED")
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["status"], "COMPLETED")

    def test_stopped_stage_can_select_only_predeclared_read_only_diagnostic_branch(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            (root / "evidence.txt").write_text("preserve", encoding="utf-8")
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("primary", "TASK-PRIMARY", [{"step_id": "missing", "tool": "read_text", "path": "missing.txt"}]),
                self.stage("diagnose", "TASK-DIAGNOSE", [{"step_id": "fingerprint", "tool": "file_fingerprint", "path": "evidence.txt"}],
                           {"stage_id": "primary", "status": "STOPPED"}),
            ])

            result = run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)

            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "STOPPED")
            self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in result["stages"]], ["STOPPED", "COMPLETED"])
            self.assertEqual((root / "evidence.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "preserve")
            events = [json.loads(line) for line in ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["status"], "STOPPED")

    def test_branch_not_selected_is_skipped_without_running_its_actions(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            (root / "evidence.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("first", "TASK-FIRST", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"}]),
                self.stage("on-stop", "TASK-STOP-BRANCH", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "missing.txt"}],
                           {"stage_id": "first", "status": "STOPPED"}),
            ])

            result = run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)

            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "COMPLETED")
            self.assertEqual(result["stages"][1]["status"], "SKIPPED")
            self.assertIn("condition not met", result["stages"][1]["reason"])

    def test_explicit_null_condition_is_rejected_by_parser(self):
        stage = self.stage("first", "TASK-NULL", [
            {"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"},
        ])
        stage["when"] = None

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
            AgentRequestError, r"stages\[0\]\.when must contain exactly stage_id and status"
        ):
            parse_workflow(self.workflow([stage]))

    def test_null_condition_in_any_stage_rejects_before_actions_or_ledger_locks(self):
        for null_index in range(3):
            with self.subTest(null_index=null_index), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                target = root / "evidence.txt"
                target.write_text("preserve", encoding="utf-8")
                ledger = root / "ledger" / "events.jsonl"
                stages = [
                    self.stage(f"stage-{index}", f"TASK-{index}", [
                        {"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"},
                    ])
                    for index in range(3)
                ]
                stages[null_index]["when"] = None

                with (
                    patch("ario_workflow.run_task") as execute,
                    patch("ario_workflow._append_event") as append_event,
                    patch("ario_workflow.os.open") as open_lock,
                ):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                        AgentRequestError,
                        rf"stages\[{null_index}\]\.when must contain exactly stage_id and status",
                    ):
                        run_workflow(self.workflow(stages), root, ledger)

                execute.assert_not_called()
                append_event.assert_not_called()
                open_lock.assert_not_called()
                self.assertFalse(ledger.parent.exists())
                self.assertFalse(ledger.exists())
                self.assertFalse(ledger.with_name(ledger.name + ".workflow.lock").exists())
                self.assertFalse(ledger.with_name(ledger.name + ".lock").exists())
                self.assertEqual(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "preserve")

    def test_writes_are_rejected_in_a_stopped_branch_before_any_execution(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("first", "TASK-FIRST", [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}]),
                self.stage("on-stop", "TASK-STOP-WRITE", [{
                    "step_id": "write", "tool": "replace_text", "path": "file.txt",
                    "content": "x", "expected_sha256": "0" * 64,
                }], {"stage_id": "first", "status": "STOPPED"}),
            ])

            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "read-only actions only"):
                parse_workflow(payload)
            self.assertFalse(ledger.exists())

    def test_any_write_stage_after_failure_is_skipped_even_if_other_condition_matches(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            target = root / "file.txt"
            target.write_text("unchanged", encoding="utf-8")
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("first", "TASK-FAIL", [{"step_id": "missing", "tool": "read_text", "path": "absent.txt"}]),
                self.stage("diagnose", "TASK-DIAG", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "file.txt"}],
                           {"stage_id": "first", "status": "STOPPED"}),
                self.stage("unsafe-followup", "TASK-WRITE", [{
                    "step_id": "replace", "tool": "replace_text", "path": "file.txt",
                    "content": "changed", "expected_sha256": "0" * 64,
                }], {"stage_id": "diagnose", "status": "COMPLETED"}),
            ])

            result = run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)

            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "STOPPED")
            self.assertEqual(result["stages"][2]["status"], "SKIPPED")
            self.assertIn("write-capable stage skipped", result["stages"][2]["reason"])
            self.assertEqual(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "unchanged")

    def test_rejects_forward_reference_duplicate_ids_and_unknown_fields(self):
        base = self.workflow([
            self.stage("first", "TASK-1", [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}]),
            self.stage("second", "TASK-2", [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}],
                       {"stage_id": "future", "status": "COMPLETED"}),
        ])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "earlier stage"):
            parse_workflow(base)
        duplicate = self.workflow([
            self.stage("same", "TASK-1", [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}]),
            self.stage("same", "TASK-2", [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}]),
        ])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "stage_id must be unique"):
            parse_workflow(duplicate)
        unknown = {**self.workflow([self.stage("one", "TASK-1", [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}])]), "shell": "no"}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "exactly workflow_id"):
            parse_workflow(unknown)

    def test_stage_count_accepts_eight_and_rejects_nine(self):
        stages = [
            self.stage(
                f"stage-{index}",
                f"TASK-{index}",
                [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}],
            )
            for index in range(1, 9)
        ]

        parsed = parse_workflow(self.workflow(stages))
        self.assertEqual(len(parsed["stages"]), 8)

        too_many_stages = [
            self.stage(
                f"stage-{index}",
                f"TASK-{index}",
                [{"step_id": "status", "tool": "git_status"}],
            )
            for index in range(1, 10)
        ]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "between 1 and 8 stages"):
            parse_workflow(self.workflow(too_many_stages))

    def test_eight_stage_workflow_executes_and_records_every_stage(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            (root / "evidence.txt").write_text("observed", encoding="utf-8")
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            stages = [
                self.stage(
                    f"stage-{index}",
                    f"TASK-{index}",
                    [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"}],
                )
                for index in range(1, 9)
            ]

            result = run_workflow(
                self.workflow(stages, workflow_id="WF-EIGHT-STAGES"), root, ledger
            )

            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "COMPLETED")
            self.assertEqual([stage["status"] for stage in result["stages"]], ["COMPLETED"] * 8)
            events = [json.loads(line) for line in ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
            stage_events = [
                event for event in events if event["event"] == "WORKFLOW_STAGE_OBSERVED"
            ]
            self.assertEqual([event["stage_id"] for event in stage_events], [
                f"stage-{index}" for index in range(1, 9)
            ])
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["event"], "WORKFLOW_FINISHED")
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["status"], "COMPLETED")

    def test_duplicate_workflow_id_is_rejected_before_new_stages(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            ledger.write_text(json.dumps({"event": "WORKFLOW_FINISHED", "workflow_id": "WF-DUP"}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            target = root / "evidence.txt"
            target.write_text("unchanged", encoding="utf-8")
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("inspect", "TASK-NEW", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"}]),
            ], workflow_id="WF-DUP")

            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "refusing duplicate execution"):
                run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)
            self.assertEqual(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "unchanged")
            self.assertEqual(len(ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()), 1)

    def test_used_task_id_in_later_stage_blocks_workflow_before_first_stage(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            target = root / "evidence.txt"
            target.write_text("unchanged", encoding="utf-8")
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            ledger.write_text(json.dumps({"event": "TASK_FINISHED", "task_id": "TASK-ALREADY-USED", "status": "COMPLETED"}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("first", "TASK-NEW", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"}]),
                self.stage("second", "TASK-ALREADY-USED", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "evidence.txt"}],
                           {"stage_id": "first", "status": "COMPLETED"}),
            ])

            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "refusing duplicate execution"):
                run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)
            events = [json.loads(line) for line in ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
            self.assertEqual(len(events), 1)
            self.assertEqual(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "unchanged")

    def test_invalid_branch_path_is_rejected_before_any_ledger_write(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            ledger = root / "events.jsonl"
            payload = self.workflow([
                self.stage("first", "TASK-1", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "ok.txt"}]),
                self.stage("second", "TASK-2", [{"step_id": "read", "tool": "read_text", "path": "../escape.txt"}],
                           {"stage_id": "first", "status": "COMPLETED"}),
            ])

            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AgentRequestError, "escapes the configured workspace"):
                run_workflow(payload, root, ledger)
            self.assertFalse(ledger.exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# W3: Synthetic Custody and Event-Comparability Laboratory (TESTS ONLY)

**Experimental research fixture, not a production witness verifier.**

This directory vendors the offline W2/W3 *mock verifier and pytest probes* reviewed on 2026-10-15 for Ario Issue #81. It does not modify the real M0, EA-0.1, ARP-0.1, RAC-0.1, TA-0.1, custody policy, trust anchor, evidence admission, or production source loader. `w2_lab_verifier.py` is a **deliberately test-only implementation** with **injected assumptions**, not an authenticated source and not a viable authority. No real private keys or trust root is accepted. Actual RAC-0.1 is imported directly from `implementation/reviewer_authorization_preflight.py` during tests; that file is **not** copied here.

## Scope, status and limits

- W2 inherited tests check exact raw payload bytes and a self-declared SHA-256 digest in a synthetic pre-enrolled *test oracle*; duplicate lineage, split reads, missing ancestry, wrong audience, revoked or expired mock grants and invalid metadata cannot create admission authority.
- W3-F03 (two declared witness labels, distinct roots, same declared custodian): `UNKNOWN / SHARED_CUSTODIAN_NOT_INDEPENDENT`.
- W3-F04 (reviewer is an exact source custodian): `REJECTED / REVIEWER_SOURCE_CONFLICT`.
- W3-F05 (identical status label but different declared event types): `UNKNOWN / EVENT_TYPE_MISMATCH`.
- W3-F06 (identical event type and status but distinct declared `event_id`s): `UNKNOWN / EVENT_INSTANCE_MISMATCH`; one-sided/malformed IDs also remain `UNKNOWN`. Equal IDs are only *declarations*, never authenticated identity of a historical event.
- Diagnostic precedence: known shared ancestry is reported before repeated custodian, preserving earlier controls. In injected synthetic tests, a valid-looking mock outcome is **only** `LAB_REVIEWABLE_ONLY / MOCK_ONLY_NO_AUTHORITY`, always with `admission_decision=NOT_EVALUATED`, `claim_truth=UNKNOWN`, `source_authentication=NOT_ESTABLISHED_IN_PRODUCTION`.
- The *real* Ario RAC preflight remains non-authorizing: `UNKNOWN` or `REJECTED`. There is no native TB→M0 evidence bridge or production admission implementation in this directory.
- **No historical witness independence can be inferred from equal/different mock names.** The offline oracle is specified by the test itself; it is not externally authentic or independent. Matching `event` values describe event *types*, not necessarily one event instance.

## Verification and provenance

Source lab archive: `Ario_W3_Custody_Conflict_Lab_2026-10-15.zip`; independently checked SHA-256 `f9cf9fbb0c9ff50d1ec5a7acb5d38cd305a19569ff03343ac431a918afae4523` (local artifact, **not** a GitHub release or a signed independent attestation). The complete archive retained the original RED logs (`3 failed, 3 passed`), intermediate diagnostic priority regression (`2 failed, 31 passed`) and GREEN run (`39 passed`). These records verify the *mock lab* behavior within the stated boundaries only.

Original six laboratory source/test files are reproduced here byte-for-byte except for the two-sentence module docstring in `test_w2_rac_crosslayer.py` explaining that this PR uses the actual repository RAC module rather than vendoring a copy.

Run from `implementation/`:

```sh
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/w3_lab
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests
```

Test output is a local/CI result, **not** validation of unobserved attackers, positive real-world authenticity, independently governed source enrollment, genuine external clocks/revocation, or claim truth.

## Review gate

Keep this work as a separate test-only draft PR until independent adversarial review of the copied mock implementation, injected-oracle boundary, actual RAC import, test assertion sensitivity, unexpected file writes, and GitHub CI on its exact head. Issue #81 must remain open after merge; positive evidence admission and trust root activation require entirely separate security and governance approval.

===== BEGIN_FILE 084 PATH="implementation/tests/w3_lab/test_w2_lab_verifier.py" ORIGINAL_BYTES=10802 ENCODING=UTF8_VERBATIM GIT_SHA1=3f4198520ab9c394e6c5f5d44559b10a6d347a5b SHA256=961f398cdc4e9eb9123f8819355c9b8277dc93a7dc5f5ae0bc34dfa9ec57c7ee =====
"""Synthetic W2 negative-control fixtures: no Ario runtime or production trust."""
from dataclasses import replace
from hashlib import sha256
import pytest
from w2_lab_verifier import (
    Source, SourceBinding, ReviewGrant, Request, SyntheticOracles,
    inspect, parse_strict_metadata, mock_candidate_digest,
)

PAYLOAD = b'{"event":"TASK_FINISHED","reported_status":"COMPLETED"}\n'
DIGEST = sha256(PAYLOAD).hexdigest()
TARGET = dict(claim_id="C1", scope="Ledger reports an event", use="INDEPENDENT_TARGET_SUPPORT",
              audience="LAB-ARIO", epoch="LAB-EPOCH-A")


def baseline():
    source = Source(label="CLAIMED-WITNESS-A", locator="blob-A", claimed_digest=DIGEST,
                    custodian="CUSTODIAN-A", root="ROOT-A", parents=("ORIGIN-A",), **TARGET)
    bound = SourceBinding(actual_digest=DIGEST, custodian=source.custodian,
                          root=source.root, parents=source.parents, **TARGET)
    request = Request(sources=(source,), reviewer="REVIEWER-A", proposer="PROPOSER-A",
                      grant_id="GRANT-A", action="REVIEW_CANDIDATE", **TARGET)
    grant = ReviewGrant("REVIEWER-A", "REVIEW_CANDIDATE", "C1",
                        TARGET["scope"], "LAB-ARIO", "LAB-EPOCH-A", 20, 40,
                        mock_candidate_digest(request))
    oracle = SyntheticOracles(payload_store={"blob-A": PAYLOAD},
                              authenticated_sources={"blob-A": bound},
                              externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset({"ROOT-A"}),
                              review_grants={"GRANT-A": grant},
                              revocation={"GRANT-A": "FRESH_ACTIVE"}, trusted_now=30)
    return request, oracle


def with_oracle(oracle, **changes):
    return replace(oracle, **changes)


def assert_result(result, status, reason):
    assert result.status == status
    assert result.reason == reason
    assert result.admission_decision == "NOT_EVALUATED"
    assert result.claim_truth == "UNKNOWN"
    assert result.source_authentication == "NOT_ESTABLISHED_IN_PRODUCTION"


def test_w2_p01_only_mock_reviewability_not_real_admission():
    r, o = baseline()
    assert_result(inspect(r, o), "LAB_REVIEWABLE_ONLY", "MOCK_ONLY_NO_AUTHORITY")


def test_w2_n01_stale_digest_with_real_bytes_is_rejected():
    r, o = baseline()
    changed = PAYLOAD.replace(b"COMPLETED", b"FAILED")
    assert sha256(changed).hexdigest() != DIGEST
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, payload_store={"blob-A": changed})),
                  "REJECTED", "PAYLOAD_DIGEST_MISMATCH")


def test_w2_n01b_stale_digest_with_no_bytes_is_unknown():
    r, o = baseline()
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, payload_store={})),
                  "UNKNOWN", "PAYLOAD_NOT_RETRIEVABLE")


def test_w2_n02_two_forged_labels_are_not_two_roots():
    r, o = baseline()
    a = r.sources[0]
    b = replace(a, label="CLAIMED-WITNESS-B", locator="blob-B")
    bound = o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"]
    forged = replace(r, sources=(a, b))
    oracle = with_oracle(o, payload_store={"blob-A": PAYLOAD, "blob-B": PAYLOAD},
                         authenticated_sources={"blob-A": bound, "blob-B": bound})
    assert_result(inspect(forged, oracle), "UNKNOWN", "SHARED_ANCESTRY_NOT_INDEPENDENT")


def test_w2_n03_different_bytes_same_source_parent_cannot_inflate():
    r, o = baseline()
    original = r.sources[0]
    other_bytes = PAYLOAD + b"second representation"
    other_digest = sha256(other_bytes).hexdigest()
    other = replace(original, locator="blob-B", claimed_digest=other_digest,
                    root="ROOT-B", custodian="CUSTODIAN-B", label="WITNESS-B")
    other_bound = replace(o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], actual_digest=other_digest,
                          custodian="CUSTODIAN-B", root="ROOT-B", parents=("ORIGIN-A",))
    # The declared parent is deliberately forged, unlike the oracle's source.
    req = replace(r, sources=(original, replace(other, parents=("FAKE-UNRELATED",))))
    oracle = with_oracle(o,
        payload_store={"blob-A": PAYLOAD, "blob-B": other_bytes},
        authenticated_sources={"blob-A": o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], "blob-B": other_bound},
        externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset({"ROOT-A", "ROOT-B"}))
    # Deliberate mismatch between claimed ancestry and verified binding is detected first.
    assert_result(inspect(req, oracle), "REJECTED", "SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH")
    req = replace(r, sources=(original, replace(other, parents=("ORIGIN-A",))))
    assert_result(inspect(req, oracle), "UNKNOWN", "SHARED_ANCESTRY_NOT_INDEPENDENT")


def test_w2_n04_omitted_lineage_remains_unknown():
    r, o = baseline()
    req = replace(r, sources=(replace(r.sources[0], parents=None),))
    assert_result(inspect(req, o), "UNKNOWN", "ANCESTRY_OMITTED")


def test_w2_n05_forged_signature_and_self_enrolled_root_not_trusted():
    r, o = baseline()
    assert r.sources[0].signature_claim
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset())),
                  "UNKNOWN", "SOURCE_ROOT_UNTRUSTED")
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, authenticated_sources={})),
                  "UNKNOWN", "SOURCE_BINDING_MISSING")


def test_w2_n06_review_only_grant_cannot_authorize_admission():
    r, o = baseline()
    assert_result(inspect(replace(r, action="ADMIT_EVIDENCE"), o),
                  "REJECTED", "ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED")
    assert_result(inspect(replace(r, sources=(replace(r.sources[0], scope="Claim is true"),)), o),
                  "REJECTED", "SOURCE_TARGET_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
    assert_result(inspect(replace(r, reviewer=r.proposer), o), "REJECTED", "SELF_REVIEW")


def test_w2_n07_revoked_missing_clock_and_stale_revocation_fail_closed():
    r, o = baseline()
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, revocation={"GRANT-A": "REVOKED"})),
                  "REJECTED", "GRANT_REVOKED")
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, revocation={})),
                  "UNKNOWN", "REVOCATION_FRESHNESS_UNVERIFIED")
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, trusted_now=None)),
                  "UNKNOWN", "TRUSTED_CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE")
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, trusted_now=50)),
                  "REJECTED", "REVIEW_GRANT_EXPIRED_OR_NOT_YET_VALID")


def test_w2_n08_replay_wrong_audience_or_epoch_blocked():
    r, o = baseline()
    for key, new in (("audience", "ANOTHER-SERVICE"), ("epoch", "ANOTHER-EPOCH")):
        req = replace(r, **{key: new}, sources=(replace(r.sources[0], **{key: new}),))
        assert_result(inspect(req, o), "REJECTED", "SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH")


def test_w2_n09_duplicate_json_keys_and_nonfinite_numbers_rejected():
    for raw in (b'{"claim":"A","claim":"B"}', b'{"amount":NaN}', b'{"x":Infinity}', b'[]'):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            parse_strict_metadata(raw)
    assert parse_strict_metadata(b'{"claim":"A","n":2}') == {"claim": "A", "n": 2}


def test_w2_n10_conflicting_mock_reports_do_not_assert_truth():
    r, o = baseline()
    other_bytes = PAYLOAD.replace(b"COMPLETED", b"FAILED")
    source = replace(r.sources[0], label="WITNESS-B", locator="blob-B",
                     claimed_digest=sha256(other_bytes).hexdigest(),
                     root="ROOT-B", parents=("ORIGIN-B",), custodian="CUSTODIAN-B")
    binding = replace(o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], actual_digest=source.claimed_digest,
                      root=source.root, parents=source.parents, custodian=source.custodian)
    oracle = with_oracle(o, payload_store={"blob-A": PAYLOAD, "blob-B": other_bytes},
        authenticated_sources={"blob-A": o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], "blob-B": binding},
        externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset({"ROOT-A", "ROOT-B"}))
    # Reports explicitly disagree over the exact same declared field.
    # We preserve conflict without deciding what occurred externally.
    joint_request = replace(r, sources=(r.sources[0], source))
    mock_grant = replace(o.review_grants["GRANT-A"],
                         bound_candidate_digest=mock_candidate_digest(joint_request))
    oracle = with_oracle(oracle, review_grants={"GRANT-A": mock_grant})
    result = inspect(joint_request, oracle)
    assert_result(result, "UNKNOWN", "CONFLICTING_REPORTED_STATUSES")


def test_w2_n11_incorrect_source_binding_is_rejected_even_for_matching_digest():
    r, o = baseline()
    certified = replace(o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], custodian="OTHER-CUSTODIAN")
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, authenticated_sources={"blob-A": certified})),
                  "REJECTED", "SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH")


def test_w2_n12_no_synthetic_authority_can_change_original_payloads():
    r, o = baseline()
    raw = o.payload_store["blob-A"]
    digest = sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    for _ in range(2):
        inspect(r, o)
    assert o.payload_store["blob-A"] == raw
    assert sha256(o.payload_store["blob-A"]).hexdigest() == digest


def test_w2_n02b_identical_bytes_with_distinct_mock_roots_still_not_proven_independent():
    r, o = baseline()
    a = r.sources[0]
    b = replace(a, label="OTHER-WITNESS", locator="blob-B", root="ROOT-B",
                parents=("ORIGIN-B",), custodian="CUSTODIAN-B")
    binding = replace(o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], root="ROOT-B",
                      parents=("ORIGIN-B",), custodian="CUSTODIAN-B")
    oracle = with_oracle(o, payload_store={"blob-A": PAYLOAD, "blob-B": PAYLOAD},
        authenticated_sources={"blob-A": o.authenticated_sources["blob-A"], "blob-B": binding},
        externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset({"ROOT-A", "ROOT-B"}))
    assert_result(inspect(replace(r, sources=(a, b)), oracle),
                  "UNKNOWN", "IDENTICAL_PAYLOAD_INDEPENDENCE_UNPROVEN")


def test_w2_n13_bad_digest_size_and_missing_review_grant():
    r, o = baseline()
    req = replace(r, sources=(replace(r.sources[0], claimed_digest="deadbeef"),))
    assert_result(inspect(req, o), "REJECTED", "DIGEST_FORMAT_INVALID")
    oracle = with_oracle(o, payload_store={"blob-A": b"!" * (1024 * 1024 + 1)})
    assert_result(inspect(r, oracle), "REJECTED", "PAYLOAD_TYPE_OR_SIZE_INVALID")
    assert_result(inspect(r, with_oracle(o, review_grants={})),
                  "UNKNOWN", "REVIEW_GRANT_UNVERIFIED")


def test_w2_n14_review_grant_bound_to_candidate_cannot_be_replayed_on_other_dossier():
    r, o = baseline()
    # Rename an otherwise identical report. The same review grant no longer
    # covers the new candidate dossier, even though the payload matches.
    new_source = replace(r.sources[0], label="NEW-CLAIMED-WITNESS")
    different_dossier = replace(r, sources=(new_source,))
    assert mock_candidate_digest(r) != mock_candidate_digest(different_dossier)
    assert_result(inspect(different_dossier, o), "REJECTED",
                  "REVIEW_GRANT_CANDIDATE_BINDING_MISMATCH")

"""W2 synthetic-to-real RAC cross-layer *non-authority* checks.

Imports the ACTUAL reviewer_authorization_preflight module in Ario at
test runtime; no preflight implementation is duplicated in this PR.
This does NOT validate a production TB->M0 evidence bridge, Ario's M0 runtime,
or the authenticity of W2's injected SyntheticOracles.
"""
from dataclasses import replace
from hashlib import sha256

from test_w2_lab_verifier import baseline, with_oracle, PAYLOAD
from w2_lab_verifier import inspect
from reviewer_authorization_preflight import FIELDS, preflight_authorization


def rac_record(**changes):
    d = {
        "authorization_contract_version": "RAC-0.1",
        "grant_id": "GRANT-A",
        "issuer_id": "LAB-ISSUER-NOT-TRUSTED",
        "issuer_trust_basis": "externally_enrolled_roots in synthetic oracle only",
        "principal_id": "REVIEWER-A",
        "identity_binding_method": "unverified lab declaration",
        "permitted_action": "REVIEW_CANDIDATE",
        "policy_version": "ARP-0.1",
        "claim_scope": "Ledger reports an event",
        "candidate_binding": "unverified-lab-envelope",
        "validity_start": "20",
        "validity_end": "40",
        "verification_time_basis": "mock-clock-30",
        "revocation_reference": "mock-registry",
        "revocation_check": "ACTIVE",
        "separation_of_duties": "CLAIMED_INDEPENDENT",
        "signature_or_attestation": "MOCK_SIGNATURE",
        "verification_result": "VERIFIED_FOR_REVIEW_ONLY",
        "grant_limitations": "review only",
        "rule_version": "RAC-0.1",
    }
    assert set(d) == FIELDS
    d.update(changes)
    return d


def test_w2_mock_positive_does_not_cross_real_rac_authority_boundary():
    request, oracle = baseline()
    local = inspect(request, oracle)

    assert real["authorization_decision"] == "NOT_CHECKED"
    assert real["admission_decision"] == "NOT_EVALUATED"

"""Synthetic split-read payload substitution: same bytes must be checked and interpreted."""
from dataclasses import replace
from hashlib import sha256

from test_w2_lab_verifier import PAYLOAD, baseline, with_oracle
from w2_lab_verifier import inspect, mock_candidate_digest


def test_w2_n15_no_unverified_second_payload_read_may_hide_conflicting_report():
    request, oracle = baseline()
    a = request.sources[0]
    verified_b = PAYLOAD.replace(b'COMPLETED', b'FAILED')
    attack_b = PAYLOAD
    b = replace(a, label='MOCK-WITNESS-B', locator='blob-B',
                claimed_digest=sha256(verified_b).hexdigest(),
                root='ROOT-B', parents=('ORIGIN-B',), custodian='CUSTODIAN-B')
    binding_b = replace(oracle.authenticated_sources['blob-A'],
                        actual_digest=b.claimed_digest, root=b.root,
                        parents=b.parents, custodian=b.custodian)
    joint = replace(request, sources=(a, b))
    grant = replace(oracle.review_grants['GRANT-A'],
                    bound_candidate_digest=mock_candidate_digest(joint))

    class SwitchingStore(dict):
        def get(self, key, default=None):
            return super().get(key, default)   # verified bytes checked here
        def __getitem__(self, key):
            if key == 'blob-B':
                return attack_b                  # same locator, different raw bytes
            return super().__getitem__(key)

    normal = with_oracle(oracle,
        payload_store={'blob-A': PAYLOAD, 'blob-B': verified_b},
        authenticated_sources={'blob-A': oracle.authenticated_sources['blob-A'], 'blob-B': binding_b},
        externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset({'ROOT-A', 'ROOT-B'}),
        review_grants={'GRANT-A': grant})
    control = inspect(joint, normal)
    assert (control.status, control.reason) == ('UNKNOWN', 'CONFLICTING_REPORTED_STATUSES')

    switched = inspect(joint, replace(normal, payload_store=SwitchingStore(normal.payload_store)))
    # The security-relevant parsing must operate on the SAME retrieved bytes
    # whose SHA-256 was checked; no second unverified read may hide a conflict.
    assert (switched.status, switched.reason) == ('UNKNOWN', 'CONFLICTING_REPORTED_STATUSES')


def test_w2_n16_repeated_locator_is_read_only_once_per_audit():
    req, o = baseline()
    a = req.sources[0]
    b = replace(a, label='DIFFERENT-CALLER-LABEL')
    joint = replace(req, sources=(a, b))

    class CountingStore(dict):
        count = 0
        def get(self, key, default=None):
            self.count += 1
            return super().get(key, default)

    store = CountingStore(o.payload_store)
    outcome = inspect(joint, with_oracle(o, payload_store=store))
    assert outcome.status == 'UNKNOWN'
    assert outcome.reason == 'SHARED_ANCESTRY_NOT_INDEPENDENT'
    assert store.count == 1, 'reusing the same locator must not trigger a second read'


def test_w2_n17_malformed_provenance_parent_list_not_treated_as_a_verified_graph():
    req, o = baseline()
    source = replace(req.sources[0], parents='ORIGIN-A')
    joint = replace(req, sources=(source,))
    # Even a lab oracle declaration must not certify malformed ancestry types.
    binding = replace(o.authenticated_sources['blob-A'], parents='ORIGIN-A')
    grant = replace(o.review_grants['GRANT-A'],
                    bound_candidate_digest=mock_candidate_digest(joint))
    oracle = with_oracle(o, authenticated_sources={'blob-A': binding},
                         review_grants={'GRANT-A': grant})
    outcome = inspect(joint, oracle)
    assert outcome.status in {'UNKNOWN', 'REJECTED'}
    assert outcome.admission_decision == 'NOT_EVALUATED'

"""W3 synthetic laboratory RED controls, never authentication/admission tests.

These oracles are test-injected assumptions, not a real witness or signer.

from dataclasses import replace
from hashlib import sha256

from test_w2_lab_verifier import PAYLOAD, baseline, with_oracle, assert_result
from w2_lab_verifier import inspect, mock_candidate_digest

SECOND = b'{"event":"TASK_FINISHED","reported_status":"COMPLETED","witness":"B"}\n'
OTHER_EVENT = b'{"event":"AUDIT_FINISHED","reported_status":"COMPLETED","witness":"B"}\n'
CONFLICT = b'{"event":"TASK_FINISHED","reported_status":"FAILED","witness":"B"}\n'


def pair_case(raw=SECOND, *, second_custodian="CUSTODIAN-B", reviewer=None):
    """Two distinct mock roots + mock parents + payloads; NOT real independence."""
    req, oracle = baseline()
    a = req.sources[0]
    b = replace(
        a,
        label="LAB-WITNESS-B", locator="blob-B", claimed_digest=sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        custodian=second_custodian, root="ROOT-B", parents=("ORIGIN-B",),
    )
    binding = replace(
        oracle.authenticated_sources["blob-A"],
        actual_digest=b.claimed_digest, custodian=b.custodian, root=b.root,
        parents=b.parents,
    )
    req = replace(req, sources=(a, b), reviewer=(reviewer or req.reviewer))
    grant = replace(oracle.review_grants["GRANT-A"], reviewer=req.reviewer,
                    bound_candidate_digest=mock_candidate_digest(req))
    oracle = with_oracle(
        oracle,
        payload_store={"blob-A": PAYLOAD, "blob-B": raw},
        authenticated_sources={"blob-A": oracle.authenticated_sources["blob-A"],
                               "blob-B": binding},
        externally_enrolled_roots=frozenset({"ROOT-A", "ROOT-B"}),
        review_grants={"GRANT-A": grant},
    )
    return req, oracle


def test_w3_red_f03_same_custodian_different_roots_not_independent():
    req, oracle = pair_case(second_custodian="CUSTODIAN-A")
    assert req.sources[0].claimed_digest != req.sources[1].claimed_digest
    assert req.sources[0].root != req.sources[1].root
    assert req.sources[0].custodian == req.sources[1].custodian
    assert_result(inspect(req, oracle), "UNKNOWN", "SHARED_CUSTODIAN_NOT_INDEPENDENT")


def test_w3_red_f04_reviewer_controls_source_despite_distinct_proposer():
    req, oracle = pair_case(reviewer="CUSTODIAN-A")
    assert req.reviewer != req.proposer
    assert req.reviewer == req.sources[0].custodian
    assert_result(inspect(req, oracle), "REJECTED", "REVIEWER_SOURCE_CONFLICT")

    req, oracle = pair_case(raw=OTHER_EVENT)
    assert req.sources[0].root != req.sources[1].root
    assert_result(inspect(req, oracle), "UNKNOWN", "EVENT_TYPE_MISMATCH")
